text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara conveys a message from President Hafez al-Assad to Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and stresses that Israel is driving the peace process to collapse.
- Arab League says peace requires Israeli withdrawal from all Arab territories.

- The Syrian committee for rationalisation of imports and exports permits imports of more than 20 kinds of goods paid for with hard currency earned from exports. It also allows the private sector to keep all of the hard currency gained from exporting lentils and chick-peas.
- Arab foreign ministers demand Israel withdraws fully from the occupied Arab lands and renew their support for Syria, Lebanon and the Palestinians' stands.
- Assad discusses bilateral relations with Saudi military chief.
